description: Na₅FeO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.44 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.83 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.51 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.54 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.65 Å. Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.90 Å) and two longer (1.93 Å) Fe-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-72°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-70°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom.
